---- MODULE Case ----
EXTENDS Naturals, TLC
(* --algorithm A variables x=0; begin L:if x=0 then x:=1; elsif x=1 then skip; else x:=2; end if; B:skip; end algorithm *)
====
generated_body:
VARIABLES pc, x

vars == << pc, x >>

Init == (* Global variables *)
        /\ x = 0
        /\ pc = "L"

L == /\ pc = "L"
     /\ IF x=0
           THEN /\ x' = 1
           ELSE /\ IF x=1
                      THEN /\ TRUE
                           /\ x' = x
                      ELSE /\ x' = 2
     /\ pc' = "B"

B == /\ pc = "B"
     /\ TRUE
     /\ pc' = "Done"
     /\ x' = x

(* Allow infinite stuttering to prevent deadlock on termination. *)
Terminating == pc = "Done" /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next == L \/ B
           \/ Terminating

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

Termination == <>(pc = "Done")
